request.description: Danh dau tat ca da doc
Upload file 3D (glb/gltf/obj/fbx) hoac video 360 do. Kich hoat Asset Optimization Pipeline tu dong.
Lay duong dan file .glb/.gltf da toi uu cho Three.js render.
Cau hinh WebXR cho tinh nang AR uom thu ti le 1:1.
Danh sach linh kien cho tinh nang Exploded View (boc tach linh kien).
Gui yeu cau su dung AI de quet mau 3D tu video smartphone.
Theo doi tien do xu ly cua dich vu so hoa 3D.
Lich su ho so so (Digital Passport) cua san pham.
Them moi log vao ho so so cua san pham.
Tong quan ho so so: tong su kien, 5 su kien gan nhat, phan loai.
Thong ke day du cho seller: doanh thu, don hang, san pham, assets, subscription, dung luong.
Gui anh cay trong de AI chan doan benh (provider: vit_local / gemini / openai)
